title: Banff Private Tour: Moraine, Louise, Peyto & Icefields Parkway
includes: Complimentary use of hiking gear - Hiking poles, blankets, headlamps...
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the Rockies’ most iconic alpine lakes in style on this PRIVATE LUXURY tour from Banff or Canmore—at a time of your choosing. Travel comfortably in a premium Mercedes Sprinter as you visit four breathtaking gems: Moraine Lake, Lake Louise, Peyto Lake, Bow Lake, Mistaya Canyon and the famous Athabasca Glacier. Enjoy personalized service, skip the crowds, and explore at your own pace. From turquoise waters to glacier-carved peaks, this is the ultimate Canadian Rockies experience; perfect for families, or small groups seeking a first-class adventure.
